title: Insurance Claims Awaiting Adjudication — Allowance on Renewal Notice Deadlines
content:
An insurance claim still awaiting its payer's decision lengthens the response days of a renewal's missing-information notice under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care). Days are added while an insurer has yet to decide a claim of the patient, the explanation of benefits being part of what documents the patient's medical debt.

1. When a claim of the patient (Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)) is in submitted status, not yet accepted by its payer, 10 days are added.
2. When no claim is in submitted status and a claim is in accepted status, awaiting adjudication, 5 days are added.
3. Otherwise none are added for pending claims.

A patient with one claim in submitted status and another in accepted status receives 10 days, not 15: the second clause applies only when no claim is in submitted status.
